planSteps.description: Click on 'Domicilio normal' option in step 0
Click on the origin barrio search input and type 'Centro'
Select the first 'Centro' option from the dropdown
Click on the destination barrio search input and type 'Caño'
Select the first option with 'Caño' in the name from the dropdown
Enter 'Calle 10 # 15-20' in the origin direction field
Enter 'Vía al Caño Cristales' in the destination direction field
Enter '1500000' in the transferencia monto field
The price summary section should show a 'Tarifa base' line with a value greater than 0
The price summary section should show a line with text 'Entre 46 a 60 kg' and value '$ 10.000' (peso recargo for 70kg)
The price summary section should show a line with text 'Superior a $1.000.000' and value '$ 6.000' (transferencia recargo for $1.5M)
The total at the bottom should be the sum of tarifa base + $10.000 (peso) + $6.000 (transferencia)
